title: Variant snapshot differential dashboard and rollback scenario simulator
creator: Marta Alvarez
description:
Build a console-first experience that lets operators compare live and historical variant snapshots side-by-side, run hypothetical rollback scenarios against recent telemetry, and surface trace-linked root-cause suspects. This ticket delivers a new dashboard panel (Variant Snapshot Differential) plus an interactive Rollback Scenario Simulator that can replay sampled requests, estimate impact on latency/error/cost, and propose rollback thresholds for auto-rollback policies.

Goals:
- Enable fast human review of cohort deltas: per-route latency P50/P95, token-cost delta, error-class breakdown, and structured output divergence score.
- Provide trace linking so users can click from a cohort diff row to representative spans/traces and logs.
- Offer a simulator to run a proposed rollback plan (percentage, variant target, ramp speed) against recent 1h/6h telemetry and projected cost impact.
- Produce recommended auto-rollback policies with confidence bands and a suggested sample size for A/B significance.

Acceptance criteria:
1) New Variant Snapshot Differential panel appears on Rollout > Details for any active rollout, showing baseline vs variant metrics with simple significance cue (green/amber/red).
2) Each metric row includes a "View traces" link that opens the Console trace viewer filtered to representative spans.
3) Rollback Scenario Simulator accepts inputs (rollback percent, target variant, ramp window) and returns: simulated latency distribution, estimated token cost delta, projected error rate, and a confidence note.
4) Simulator output includes one-click "Create auto-rollback policy" prefilled with thresholds and sample window.
5) Unit/end-to-end tests for data aggregation pipeline, simulator logic, and permission checks are present in repos.
6) UX reviewed and signed off by Design; telemetry charts match Redwood Console styling and are performant for 1m-resolution windows.

Scope & trade-offs:
- We will sample traces for linking (rate configurable by tenant) rather than fetching every trace to keep storage/compute reasonable.
- Simulator uses recent aggregated buckets and a bootstrapped variance estimator instead of full replay for speed. Full shadow replay is planned in a follow-up ticket (PM-38722).
- Statistical significance guidance will provide a conservative default (95% CI) with a toggle for two-sided/one-sided tests.

Non-goals:
- Full synthetic traffic replay for arbitrary historical windows (out of scope for this ticket).
- Automatic rollback enactment; this ticket only creates the policy and simulation proof.
